source_caption:
🎬 Follow the Stars Home (2001)

Follow the Stars Home tells the emotional and inspiring story of Dianne Parker, a young woman whose dreams of building a happy family take an unexpected turn when she discovers that her unborn daughter may have serious disabilities. When her husband Mark struggles to accept the situation and eventually abandons their marriage, Dianne is left to face the challenges of motherhood on her own. Determined to give her daughter Julia a loving and meaningful life, she finds strength through the support of her family and Mark’s brother David, a compassionate man who has secretly loved her for years. As Dianne navigates heartbreak, financial difficulties, and the responsibilities of raising a child with special needs, she discovers the extraordinary power of unconditional love. Starring Kimberly Williams-Paisley, Campbell Scott, Eric Close, and Alexa Vega, the film delivers a touching story about motherhood, sacrifice, forgiveness, second chances, and the unbreakable bond between a mother and her child.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Romance • Family

⭐ IMDb: 7.1/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 1h 43m • TV Movie

🎥 Director: Dick Lowry

✍️ Writer: Sally Robinson

📚 Based On: The novel Follow the Stars Home by Luanne Rice.
